lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines observed; spacing is irregular with higher density in the mid-torso and wider gaps toward the posterior and anterior margins.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 7th line from the posterior, with the split occurring in the upper third of the torso mass near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three discontinuous segments: one abbreviated line on the posterior rump, one isolated short vertical dash in the mid-ventral torso, and one partial line near the anterior neck junction.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular spots are located on the lateral posterior haunch, positioned vertically between the dorsal line and the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two haunch spots align on a diagonal axis directed toward the posterior-ventral edge of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a posterior-dorsal vector from the skull with a slight inward lyrate curvature visible in the distal segments.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.4 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately the distal 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White V-shaped chevron on the bridge of the nose, two white spots on the lower cheek/mandible, and a white transverse patch on the lower throat.
